sessions: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`sessions` (`id` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `access` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `data` text, PRIMARY KEY (id));
TrustedUserGroups: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`TrustedUserGroups` (`id` INT NOT NULL,`username` VARCHAR(45) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`));
AccessDefinitions: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`AccessDefinitions` (ID INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, authname VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL UNIQUE, org TEXT NULL, menuID INT NULL, dashboardID VARCHAR(500) NULL, collectionID VARCHAR(500) NULL, maxbyday INT NULL, maxbymonth INT NULL, maxtotalaccesses INT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (ID));
ACL: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`ACL` (ID INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, defID INT NOT NULL, user VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (ID), FOREIGN KEY (defID) REFERENCES `Dashboard`.`AccessDefinitions`(ID) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);
ACLProfiles: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`ACLProfiles` (ID INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, profilename VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL UNIQUE, authIDs TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (ID));
ACLProfilesAssignment: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`ACLProfilesAssignment` (profileID INT NOT NULL, user VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (profileID, user), FOREIGN KEY (profileID) REFERENCES `Dashboard`.`ACLProfiles`(ID) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);
ACNames: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`ACNames` (name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (name));
DashboardLinkMenu: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `DashboardLinkMenu` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `linkUrl` varchar(300) NOT NULL, `icon` varchar(200) DEFAULT '', `text` varchar(200) DEFAULT '', `openMode` varchar(45) DEFAULT 'newTab', `iconColor` varchar(45) DEFAULT '#FFFFFF', `menuOrder` int(2) DEFAULT 0, `dashboardId` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `DashboardLinkMenu_idfk` (`dashboardId`)) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci;
SeedACNames: INSERT IGNORE INTO `Dashboard`.`ACNames` (name) SELECT profilename FROM `Dashboard`.`ACLProfiles` UNION SELECT authname FROM `Dashboard`.`AccessDefinitions`;
AddFK_ACLProfiles_ACNames: ALTER TABLE `Dashboard`.`ACLProfiles` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_ACLProfiles_ACNames` FOREIGN KEY (`profilename`) REFERENCES `Dashboard`.`ACNames`(`name`);
AddFK_AccessDefinitions_ACNames: ALTER TABLE `Dashboard`.`AccessDefinitions` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_AccessDefs_ACNames` FOREIGN KEY (`authname`) REFERENCES `Dashboard`.`ACNames`(`name`);
DashboardLinkMenuSubmenus: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `Dashboard`.`DashboardLinkMenuSubmenus` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `linkUrl` varchar(300) NOT NULL, `icon` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL, `text` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL, `openMode` varchar(45) DEFAULT 'newTab', `iconColor` varchar(45) DEFAULT '#FFFFFF', `menuOrder` int(2) DEFAULT NULL, `menuId` int(11) NOT NULL, `dashboardId` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `DashboardLinkMenuSubmenus_idfk` (`dashboardId`), KEY `DashboardLinkMenuSubmenus_menuidfk` (`menuId`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci;
translation_auto_runs: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS translation_auto_runs ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, request_key VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, active_slot TINYINT NULL, origin VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, requested_by VARCHAR(255) NULL, mode VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, languages_json TEXT NOT NULL, max_items INT NOT NULL, snapshot_max_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, initialized TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME NULL, heartbeat_at DATETIME NULL, launch_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL, launch_at DATETIME NULL, started_by VARCHAR(255) NULL, launch_request_key VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL, finished_at DATETIME NULL, error_code VARCHAR(80) NULL, policy_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), UNIQUE KEY request_key(request_key), UNIQUE KEY active_slot(active_slot) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
translation_auto_items: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS translation_auto_items ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, run_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, translation_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, menu_text TEXT NOT NULL, source_language VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, target_language VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, source_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, proposed_text TEXT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_attempt_at DATETIME NULL, error_code VARCHAR(80) NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), UNIQUE KEY run_item(run_id,translation_id), KEY retry_lookup(translation_id,source_hash,status), KEY run_status(run_id,status) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
